# Eldo

> Modern tools for owner-run businesses. Eldo takes the work your office does by hand and makes it happen on its own, so you can see your business from your phone.

## Who it's for

Owner-run small and mid-size businesses whose staff retype information between paper, email and older software. Examples: property and family offices, health practices and clinics, distribution and the trades, professional services.

## What Eldo does

- Stops repeated manual data entry between systems.
- Builds a simple view of the numbers an owner checks every day, available on a phone.
- Works with the software the business already has instead of replacing it.
- Keeps accounting, operations software and spreadsheets in agreement.
- Builds simple apps for work currently tracked in spreadsheets, and moves businesses off old software without stopping work.
- Handles larger work too: migrating systems a business depends on, protecting sensitive records and controlling who can see what, and systems that keep working as the business grows.

## How an engagement starts

1. A 30-minute conversation about what the office does by hand and what it costs.
2. A first look at the owner's own numbers, built on their existing system, at no charge.
3. A scoped, fixed-price project, only if the first piece earns it.
4. Optional ongoing care: keeping it running and making small changes.

Everything runs in accounts the client owns, and the client's data stays theirs.

## Who's behind it

Joseph Schwartz, with twelve years of building operational systems for city governments, a startup he co-founded, and a large enterprise.
